user.title: Connect to the Infrastructure Monitor add-on
user.description: Devices are configured in the add-on's own web interface. Open the add-on, expand 'Connection details for the Home Assistant integration' and copy the values from there.

data_description.host: The add-on's hostname on the Supervisor network, shown in the add-on's web interface.

hassio_confirm.title: Infrastructure Monitor add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the integration for the add-on running at {host}? Devices are added and configured in the add-on's own web interface.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the add-on API token
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored token. Reinstalling the add-on generates a new one; copy it from the add-on's web interface.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on. Check that it is running and that the host and port are correct.
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected that API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the add-on's data. The add-on polls the monitored devices themselves on the schedule set per device in its web interface, so this can stay short.
